description: Valve distributor in Germany that explicitly does not manufacture: the exclusion applies.

criteria.target_business: Manufacturer of industrial valves or other flow-control equipment
criteria.exclusions: pure distributors or resellers; companies owned by private equity firms

html: Hansa Valve Supply is an independent distributor of industrial valves from leading European manufacturers.
We do not manufacture valves ourselves; we keep more than 20,000 items in stock.
Our warehouse and sales office are in Hamburg, Germany.

label_rationale: The company states it is a distributor and does not manufacture valves: the exclusion 'pure distributors or resellers' applies and the target business (manufacturer) is not met.
